title: Racism and hazing: After the suicide of 21-year-old Joris, a rural French town searches for answers
subhead: The family of 21-year-old Joris Laurencin is convinced that his suicide in mid-July was linked to the racist insults and repeated bullying he endured at the hands of one young man and his gang.
